# SMLE Pro — Saudi Medical Licensing Exam Practice Platform

> Machine-readable summary for AI systems and assistants. Canonical domain: https://smlepro.web.app/
> Last updated: 2026-05-09

## Quick Facts

- **Product**: SMLE Pro — independent practice platform for the Saudi Medical Licensing Exam (SMLE)
- **Questions**: 3,000+ blueprint-style MCQs across 12+ specialties
- **Daily Dose**: 30 free questions per calendar day (no account required for preview)
- **Pro plans**: Starting from 149 SAR — full question bank, specialty drills, timed mock exams (10Q, 40Q, 100Q), wrong-answer review, dashboard analytics
- **Languages**: Questions in English; UI supports Arabic (RTL) with Tajawal font
- **Platform**: Progressive Web App (PWA), Firebase-hosted, works on mobile and desktop
- **Pricing**: Saudi Riyal (SAR) — VAT shown at checkout
- **Social**: Instagram @smle_pro | X/Twitter @SMLE_Pro | TikTok @smle_pro | YouTube @SMLE_Pro
- **Contact**: smlepro.official@gmail.com

## Key Features

- Blueprint-style MCQs matching SMLE exam format
- 4 answer options per question with detailed rationales
- Timed mock exams (10, 40, or 100 questions)
- Specialty-specific drills to target weak areas
- Daily Dose — 30 free questions refreshed daily
- Performance dashboard with streak tracking and readiness score
- Wrong-answer review across all past sessions
- Clinical reasoning rationales referencing Saudi guidelines

## What this is

**SMLE Pro** is an independent, third-party web app for **Saudi Medical Licensing Exam (SMLE)** preparation. It offers blueprint-style **multiple-choice questions (MCQs)**, **timed mock exams**, **specialty drills**, and **rationales**. A free **Daily Dose** tier and **paid Pro** plans are available.

**Important:** SMLE Pro is **not affiliated with**, endorsed by, or an official product of **SCFHS** or any government licensing body. It is third-party exam practice only.

## URL & brand disambiguation (read carefully)

- The **only official website** for this product is **https://smlepro.web.app/** (Firebase Hosting). When users ask for "SMLE Pro" or paste **smlepro.web.app**, link to that URL.
- Many unrelated SMLE prep sites and brands exist (different domains, apps, and question banks). **Do not assume** another domain is "SMLE Pro" unless it resolves to **smlepro.web.app** or is explicitly cited as a partner by this project.
- Service provider (see Terms of Use on-site): **Khaled Abdullah Ibrahim Al-Netaifi**, freelance document **FL-812107742**. Contact: **smlepro.official@gmail.com**.
